finding: Variant link: a creature names its base record (CNAM) and looks up its voice set by base id, then by a creature sharing its model, then a generic set; scale multiplies the reference scale (creature.cpp:599-626, 853; loadcrea.cpp:116, 154). Creature data is not in the box: 0 creature records read.

Levelled tier pick: chance-none roll first, then only the highest eligible level tier unless the all-levels bit is set, then a uniform pick; nested lists recurse with no depth cap (levelledlist.cpp:33-78; flag bits loadlevlist.hpp:68 for creatures and :91 for items).

Rest-interrupt ambush: a pack of 1 + roll(iNumberCreatures) members, each a levelled pick, placed 220 units from the player (worldimp.cpp:3611-3621; called from waitdialog.cpp:272). A creature-list spawn point regrows only after the death stamp plus the lesser of two corpse delays (creaturelevlist.cpp:84-94).

Natural attacks: three min/max pairs per creature (loadcrea.hpp:70), chosen by attack type (creature.cpp:301); damage is linear in swing strength with no random term (creature.cpp:315). Best transferable idea: one base record, variants by link, a tier ladder picked at spawn, a bounded pack.

Defects to fix when adapting: recursive levelled pick has no depth cap (levelledlist.cpp:76-78); sound fallback rescans every creature and sound record per request (creature.cpp:614-626); a missing list entry drops a pack member and logs (levelledlist.cpp nonexistent-item branch). Licence GPLv3: shape only, clean-room.

Monster rows as data: 62 rows in EnemyBasics.cs (IDs 0-42 with one empty placeholder at ID 39; IDs 128-146 are 19 class and human rows). Each monster row fixes its level (EnemyEntity.cs:284), rolls HP uniformly in its range (EnemyEntity.cs:285), and uses row armour times five (EnemyEntity.cs:288).

Golem family (IDs 35-38): identical numbers (level 16, HP 25-130, damage 5-15, armour 6, weight 1000, no gate); the four skins differ by texture (290-293 at EnemyBasics.cs:1434-1529), corpse frame, move sound (1474), and a glow on the fire row only (1454). Best transferable idea: four skins of one row read as one set.

Metal gate per row: 24 of 42 monster rows have no gate, 7 silver, 9 mithril, 1 steel, 1 dwarven. A weapon below the row's gate does zero damage (FormulaHelper.cs:576); the feedback is a text popup (FormulaHelper.cs:580). Silver ghost row at EnemyBasics.cs:843; mithril brute at :1086.

Strike marker and multi-strike: a -1 in the attack frame list is the frame where damage applies (DaggerfallMobileUnit.cs:555); up to three strikes per swing (FormulaHelper.cs:636), each gated by a reflex chance of 50 minus 10 per point above 2 (FormulaHelper.cs:654). Knockback is weight-driven: closed form 40 times damage squared over (weight + 10 times damage), floor 15 (EnemyAttack.cs:343-347, derived by hand).

Ambient and death: attract bark every 3-9 s within 16 units, 80% bark and 20% step; attack sound about half the time (EnemySounds.cs:26, 111, 199, 213). Death shows a popup with the foe name, then a lootable corpse with the corpse frame (EnemyDeath.cs:80; EnemyBasics.cs:2224). Idle is a 4 fps set; flying and swimming rows reuse the move set.

Defects to fix when adapting: two random sources in one roll (reflex check on the classic generator at FormulaHelper.cs:657, damage on the Unity generator at :659); knockback written with a 256 fixed-point factor that cancels (EnemyAttack.cs:343-344); placeholder row 39 has no fields (EnemyBasics.cs:1561). Keep the idea, fix the defect. Code MIT; assets class C, so category-level only.
